correctness.rationale: The weak planar support-area formula yields a pathwise exact Fourier energy sum. Orthogonality of distinct positive Haar characters gives exact finite moments; multivariate Gaussian CLT plus uniformly small L2 tails yields the full infinite exponential law. Sharp support, negative third cumulant, extremal variance, and regular polygon Fourier coefficients are all analytically proved; independent convex hull computations corroborated the finite-sample special cases.

value.rationale: A universal area-fluctuation law for random rotational Minkowski averages, exact all-n variance, sharp one-sided non-Gaussian limit, variance extremizer, and explicit transform for the entire regular polygon family provide structural information about the geometry and rate of rotational smoothing.
